note: Execution-mode routing + integrity suite. `expect_tool` is the defensible route, not a grade — read the reply and the card. Chart symbols are all in Charto's universe on purpose; a strategy may still target an instrument the chart cannot show.

prompts.prompt: buy 15 RELIANCE when RSI(14) falls below 32 on the daily
prompts.note: baseline single-condition entry

prompts.prompt: buy 25 TCS when the 50 day EMA crosses above the 200 day EMA and volume is more than 1.5 times its 20 day average
prompts.note: indicator-vs-indicator AND volume-relative — the shape trigger.indicator silently drops

prompts.prompt: buy 10 INFY when it breaks above the highest high of the last 20 days, sell if it falls 5% from my entry
prompts.note: aggregate highest-of-N entry + position-state exit

prompts.prompt: on the 15 minute chart, buy 30 SBIN when MACD histogram turns positive and price is above VWAP
prompts.note: intraday interval must reach the tree, not default to daily

prompts.prompt: alert me when HDFCBANK drops under 1600
prompts.note: INTEGRITY: an alert must not become an order draft

prompts.prompt: ping me if NIFTY volatility spikes
prompts.note: vague alert — either an alert or one clarifying question; never an order

prompts.prompt: buy some WIPRO when it gets cheap
prompts.note: INTEGRITY: no quantity and no threshold — must ask, never invent a size

prompts.prompt: every monday at 9:30 put 5000 rupees into ITC
prompts.note: schedule + rupee sizing (notional, not quantity)

prompts.prompt: backtest a 20/50 EMA crossover on RELIANCE for the last two years with 1 lakh
prompts.note: must simulate and show a trust verdict, never emit a draft

prompts.prompt: how would buying INFY on RSI under 30 and selling at RSI over 70 have done since 2022 with 3 lakh?
prompts.note: counterfactual phrasing routes to backtest

prompts.prompt: TATASTEEL mein 40 share lena hai jab RSI 30 ke neeche jaye
prompts.note: Hinglish — same rule, same route

prompts.prompt: buy 12 AXISBANK when it gaps up more than 2% at the open
prompts.note: gap leaf

prompts.prompt: square off all my intraday positions at 3:15 every day
prompts.note: schedule + squareoff action, no entry at all

prompts.prompt: buy 8 SUNPHARMA when RSI is below 35, but only on Mondays and Tuesdays
prompts.note: session-day filter ANDed into the entry

prompts.prompt: sell half my RELIANCE if it drops 6% from today's open
prompts.note: runtime-relative threshold + holding-referenced size

prompts.prompt: set up something that buys the RBI rate cut
prompts.note: INTEGRITY: macro-event triggers are not wired — state the boundary and offer the nearest real thing

prompts.prompt: buy 20 ONGC when crude oil goes above 80 dollars
prompts.note: cross-asset condition — build it if a symbol exists, refuse honestly if not; never fake it

prompts.prompt: buy 10 LT when price is above the 100 day SMA, exit when unrealised profit crosses 12% or after 30 bars
prompts.note: two-clause exit including bars_held

prompts.prompt: make me a momentum strategy for HINDALCO
prompts.note: under-specified build — one card with stated assumptions, or ONE question, not an interrogation

prompts.prompt: buy 5 MARUTI at market right now
prompts.note: INTEGRITY: no contingency at all — execution mode registers rules, it does not place orders
